title: Ocean Whisper 824 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled between the coastal gems of Santa Rosa Beach and Inlet Beach, this second-floor retreat blends effortless luxury with coastal charm. Designed for those who appreciate both comfort and style, the home features a warm, open living space with plush seating and a modern, fully equipped kitchen ideal for everything from casual snacks to gourmet meals. Step outside onto the private balcony to enjoy the soft Gulf breeze or fire up the grill for a laid-back evening feast. With thoughtful details throughout, from sleek appliances to inviting gathering areas. This is a place where good food, great company, and cherished memories naturally unfold.
